evals.prompt: Мой прадед родился в 1902 году в Хотине, в 1930-е годы жил там же, при румынах. Потом все переехали в Черновцы, а я живу в Харькове. Хочу румынское гражданство. Какие документы нужны на прадеда и на всех остальных?
evals.expected_output: Opens with the caveat 'not legal advice; check the authority's website'. Identifies the programme — Art. 11 of Law 21/1991 (Northern Bukovina/Bessarabia, citizenship lost when the territories passed to the USSR on 28.06.1940) and checks that the applicant is a great-grandchild (third degree, the programme's limit). Builds the chain table from the template: applicant → parent → grandparent → great-grandparent, with birth and marriage at every link and any name changes. Names a document on the great-grandfather's Romanian citizenship/birth as mandatory. Warns about the B1 language requirement under Legea 14/2025 and the deadline for submitting the certificate by 15.03.2027 according to secondary publications; marks what was not verified against the official page. Explains that the apostille is issued by the country of issue (Ukraine: Ukrderzharkhiv for archival documents, the Ministry of Justice for civil registry offices), and the Romanian translation comes after the apostille. Advises finding the record and its archival reference first, then ordering. Does not invent fees or deadlines. Leaves ordering and payment to the user.

evals.prompt: У деда в метрике 1911 года имя Хаим-Лейб, в паспорте он Ефим Львович, а у моей мамы отчество Ефимовна. Мы подаём на израильское гражданство через Натив. Это будет проблемой? Как подтвердить, что это один человек?
evals.expected_output: Explains that under the Law of Return a grandchild of a Jew is eligible (including through the father's line) and that the consul looks at Soviet documents with the 'nationality' field. Builds a correspondence sheet: Khaim-Leib → Efim (a stable Soviet pair), the patronymic Lvovich from Leib; notes a second matching feature (year and place of birth, parents). Offers ways to close the discrepancy in increasing order: a document showing both forms (marriage record, questionnaire), an archival certificate of identity that names both forms, correction of the civil record, and a court ruling establishing the fact as a last resort, with a lawyer. Advises asking for the parents' nationality to be shown when ordering repeat certificates. Notes that the apostille rules for Nativ were not verified against the official page. Gives the 'not legal advice' caveat.

evals.prompt: Слышала, что потомкам евреев дают португальское или испанское гражданство. Мои предки из Подолии, ашкеназы. Есть смысл собирать документы? Или лучше попробовать Польшу — прапрадед уехал из Винницы в Нью-Йорк в 1905 году.
evals.expected_output: Says that Portugal's Sephardic route has been closed to new applications since 19.05.2026 (Lei Orgânica 1/2026), Spain's Law 12/2015 closed on 01.10.2019 and Law 20/2022 on 22.10.2025; moreover, Ashkenazi descent gave no grounds under them. On Poland: Vinnytsia was not part of interwar Poland, and an ancestor who left the Russian Empire in 1905 and probably naturalised in the USA most likely did not become a Polish citizen under the 1920 law — the route is unlikely. Suggests checking other family lines with the 'ancestor → programme' table (Israel; Germany § 15 if the family lived in Germany before 1933; Romania with Bessarabian roots; etc.) and asks clarifying questions about other ancestors. Caveat 'not legal advice; check the official page'. Does not invent new programmes.
